entries.title: Isaiah 48:1
segments: ¶Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, [but] not in truth, nor in righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:2
segments: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts [is] his name.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:3
segments: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did [them] suddenly, and they came to pass.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:4
segments: Because I knew that thou [art] obstinate, and thy neck [is] an iron sinew, and thy brow brass; {obstinate: Heb. hard}

entries.title: Isaiah 48:5
segments: I have even from the beginning declared [it] to thee; before it came to pass I shewed [it] thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

words.text: I have even from the beginning
[it] to thee; before it came to pass

entries.title: Isaiah 48:6
segments: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare [it]? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.

words.text: all this; and will not ye declare

entries.title: Isaiah 48:7
segments: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

them not; lest thou shouldest say

entries.title: Isaiah 48:8
segments: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time [that] thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

words.text: not; yea, from that time [that] thine ear

entries.title: Isaiah 48:9
segments: ¶For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

words.text: for thee, that I cut thee not off

entries.title: Isaiah 48:10
segments: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction. {with...: or, for silver}

entries.title: Isaiah 48:11
segments: For mine own sake, [even] for mine own sake, will I do [it]: for how should [my name] be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

words.text: For mine own sake, [even] for mine own sake, will I do
[it]: for how should [my name] be polluted

entries.title: Isaiah 48:12
segments: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I [am] he; I [am] the first, I also [am] the last.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:13
segments: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: [when] I call unto them, they stand up together. {my...: or, the palm of my right hand hath spread out}

words.text: . {my...: or, the palm of my right hand hath spread out}

entries.title: Isaiah 48:14
segments: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these [things]? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm [shall be on] the Chaldeans.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:15
segments: I, [even] I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

words.text: him, and he shall make his way

entries.title: Isaiah 48:16
segments: ¶Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there [am] I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

words.text: ye this; I have not spoken
that it was, there [am] I: and now the Lord

entries.title: Isaiah 48:17
segments: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I [am] the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way [that] thou shouldest go.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:18
segments: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

entries.title: Isaiah 48:19
segments: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

words.text: also had been as the sand
should not have been cut off

entries.title: Isaiah 48:20
segments: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it [even] to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:21
segments: And they thirsted not [when] he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:22
segments: [There is] no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
